# 🛠️ authoring

Creating skills, custom agents, commands and prompt files, instructions and rules, hooks, plugins and orchestration packs for GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and OpenAI Codex, plus auditing a whole collection. Each covers this repository's single-source format and your own project's native files.

Install: `authoring@jaktestowac`. See the [quick start](https://github.com/jaktestowac/awesome-agents-for-quality#-quick-start) for each tool.

## Commands

Run these yourself: `/name` in Claude Code and GitHub Copilot, `$name` in Codex. The agent never starts them on its own.

- [`create-skill`](skills/create-skill/SKILL.md): Create a new skill
- [`audit-collection-health`](skills/audit-collection-health/SKILL.md): Audit collection health

## Agents

| Agent | Claude Code | GitHub Copilot | Codex |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Skill Librarian - audit a customization collection | [`skill-librarian`](agents/skill-librarian.md) | [`skill-librarian`](.github/agents/skill-librarian.agent.md) | [`skill_librarian`](codex/agents/skill-librarian.toml) |

Claude Code and GitHub Copilot load these agents with the plugin.
Codex does not load agents from plugins: copy the files from [`codex/agents/`](codex/agents/) into your project's `.codex/agents/` or into `~/.codex/agents/`.
